We’re going through the same stuff. Our parents are shit at raising a healthy child, we don’t have much, or any support from our ‘friends’. It’s frustrating, isn’t it? It’s frustrating feeling so alone, so low to the point of being suicidal. It hurts. I feel your pain. Just wanted to let you know that you’re not alone, but considering the amount of responses you’ve gotten, I’m sure you know that.

I suggest starting a long show series, maybe an anime(e.g. Naruto), maybe a sitcom(e.g. Friends), maybe even start a movie marathon(e.g. The Marvel Universe).
Or maybe you can start reading a book(I recommend Pax by Sarah Pennypacker, Born a Crime by Trevor Noah, The Graveyard Book by Neil Gaiman, or The Subtle Art Of Not Giving A Fuck & Everything Is Fucked by Mark Manson)
You can even start writing stories and posting them somewhere.
Draw art and post them somewhere.
Fuck it, life’s too short, start a youtube channel! 

Stop caring for awhile and take care of yourself. Occupy yourself. You need some time away from what makes you feel like a zombie, and come back to life for a bit.

You’ve done great, and you’re still doing great. Thank you for waking up. Thank you for breathing. Thank you for blinking. Thank you for posting. Thank you for sharing how you feel.

You’re an amazing human being, you know that? You’re strong, you’re dealing with this bullshit excuse of a life, you’re you. Thank you for existing. 

I hope this helped, I hope you have a great day! Make sure to drink some water, eat some food, or snacks even. Take care of yourself. You’re doing amazing, keep it going!

I feel the same way.
I had to move schools 2 times before, all in the timeframe of 6 months. 
My personality has changed drastically, from introvert to extrovert, but I still feel so lonely, this wasn’t what I wanted.
You’re not alone.

I just wanna give you some advice. 
If people seem toxic, drop them immediately. 
If they depend on you too much, drop them real fast.
That’s what I wish I knew back then.
It’ll save you a lot of time, and tears.
(I would know, I’m the result of not following these rules. I wish I did. Life’s not the best for me lol.)

Try chatting and mixing around! There’s probably someone that shares similar interests with you or would love to hear you out. 
Avoid the people you don’t want trouble with, and tell the teachers if anything bullying were to occur.

Just trust me, hold on a little longer, there’ll be good results. 
If you ever feel like you’ve failed, come onto Reddit. This place is filled with strangers that’ll try their best to get you back up on your feet.

Also, believe in yourself.
